definitions.full: H7122. qara II. [ קָרָא ] 137 verb encounter, befall (|| form of קָרָה , q. v.; SI 4 לקרת to meet, opposite ; Arabic put part to part ; Minaean קרא set opposite , Hom Chrest. 127 ); — Qal 131 Perfect 53 masculine singular suffix קְרָאַנִי Jer 13:22 ; Job 4:2-3 ;feminine singular קָרָאת Deut 31:29 ; Jer 44:23 , etc; Imperfect 4 3masculine singular יִקְרָא Gen 49:1 , suffix יִקְרָאֶנוּ 42:4 ; 3 feminine plural וַתִּקְרֶאנָה Lev 10:19 ; Exod 1:10 read 3 feminine singular suffix תִּקְרָאֵנוּ ( ⅏ Vrss Di Ges § 47k So Kau Baen); infinitive construct 121 לקְרַאת (Ges § 19k Ol § 137 ), Gen 15:10 +, etc.; Participle feminine plural suffix קרְאִתַיִךְ Isa 51:19 ; — 1 meet, encounter , only infinitive construct לִקְרַאת often= preposition toward, against (Kö ii. l, 317 ), almost always with accusative of person, after verb of motion, Isa 7:3 ; Gen 19:1 ; 24:17 ; Judg 4:18 , 22 ; 1Kin 2:8 +; in war, battle, Judg 7:24 ; 20:25 , 31 ; 1Sam 4:1 ; 1Kin 20:27 +, after עָרַךְ 2Sam 10:9-10 , 7 +, Psa 35:3 see סגר 2b ; הַמִּלְחָמָה לִק לִבָּם ׳לְחַזֵּק Josh 11:20 to harden their heart to encounter the war with Israel; after הִנֵּה (without verb of motion), 1Sam 10:10 ; 2Sam 15:32 ; 16:1 ; 1Kin 18:7 ; Prov 7:10 ; in construction praegn. לִק ׳וַיִשְׂמַח Judg 19:3 he rejoiced to meet him , + 1Sam 6:13 ( ᵐ5 We Dr and others); לִק ׳חרד 2Kin 10:15 , נצב Exod 5:20 ; 7:15 ; Num 22:34 , etc.; redund. י ׳יִקָּרֶה ׳לִק 23:3 ; implication of helping , Isa 21:14 ; Psa 59:6 (figurative); ׳לִק נְחָשִׁים Num 24:1 he did not go to encounter (in expectation of) signs of divination ; in metaphor Isa 14:9 , || ׳לִק אֱםהֶי Amos 4:12 2 figurative befall with accusative of person, bad sense Gen 42:4 , 38 ; Deut 31:29 ; Jer 13:22 ; 44:23 ; Isa 51:19 ; Job 4:14 ; Lev 10:19 ; of war Exod 1:10 (see above) in General, Gen 49:1 . Niph`al meet unexpectedly; Perfect 3masculine singular נִקְרָא , with עַל person Exod 5:3 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּקָּרֵא , with לִפְנֵי person 2Sam 18:9 ; Perfect 20:1 with שָׁם , chanced to be there; Imperfect of bird's nest Deut 22:6 ( לִפְנֵי ); Infinitive absolute נִקְרֹא see קרה . Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine singular וַחַקְרֵא Jer 32:23 thou didst cause all this evil to befall them (accusative of person and thing). [ קְרַאת ], לִקְרַאת to meet , see II. קדא . p. 896.
